# [EPIC] Infrastructure Services

## Epic
Core infrastructure services that let the other microservices register with each other, pull centralized configuration, and sit behind one routed entry point — the platform substrate the product-facing services (movie, user, actor, ai, media) build on.

## Business Value
Without this layer, every service would need hardcoded peer URLs, its own duplicated config, and its own routing/auth/rate-limiting. This Epic centralizes all of that once instead of once per service.

## Product Goal alignment
Direct infrastructure backbone for the [Product Goal](../../docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md)'s self-hosted, production-grade microservices platform: Eureka, Config Server, and Gateway are exactly the "disciplined enough to defend in a technical interview" backend practice the goal calls for, at $0 cost (no managed service-mesh/API-gateway product).

## Child Stories
- [x] #84 — discovery, config, gateway, and a shared library in place
